name: Multiplex EasyStar
summary: Elapor foam powered glider, 1.37 m: high wing with curved-up tips, pusher Permax 400, rudder and elevator only (the roll stick works the rudder). Hand-launched, belly-landed. ~680 g.

notes.units: Units: metres, kilograms, newtons, seconds; angles in degrees where the name ends in 'Deg'. 'tuning' holds built-in changes in the Tuning tab's terms (paste an Export's "tuning" here).
notes.about: The original EasyStar (2003). Published: span 1370 mm, length 868 mm, wing area 24 dm², flying weight ~680 g, Permax 400 6V on 7-cell NiMH, 5x4 pusher prop, CG 78 mm behind the leading edge at the root. The wing, tail and prop positions are measured off the model file. Estimated: thrust, rpm, current, inertia, airfoil and drag.
notes.controls: Rudder and elevator only. rollToRudder: the roll stick works the rudder too (false: it does nothing). The curved-up wing tips give it the dihedral effect that turns rudder into roll.
notes.battery: 7-cell NiMH charges to 8.4 V, the same as a 2S LiPo, which is how it is modelled.
notes.defaultAssist: Off: the real one has no gyro. G cycles off / AS3X / SAFE, which work through the rudder.
notes.model: multiplex-easystar.glb, made in Blender (textured). The flight model's wing, tail and prop positions are measured off it (origin at the CG): if they move in Blender, update easystar.js.
